$comment: Ramapo's student office and student service sites, each by its folder on
www.ramapo.edu and the name its own home page gives it, without search-engine
wording. A site whose title is a slogan (military: "A Military Friendly College")
or a bare word (undergraduate) is named for what its pages cover.
npm run fetch:office-pages collects every page under these folders.
Reviewed September 24, 2026 against the home page title of every folder in the
site's sitemap (https://www.ramapo.edu/sitemap.xml). Left out: academic school,
department, program and research center sites (academic-sites.json); employee
and administrative offices, except Payroll, whose student payroll schedules and
pay dates student workers need, and the College Leadership page; news, the
magazine, success stories, alumni, giving and event sites; the fair trade
project. Added September 26, 2026: sustainability (Ramapo Green and the
sustainability hub) and the Havemeyer Edible Garden, which students volunteer at;
old catalogs. Sources collected elsewhere keep their own folders: the program
pages (majors-minors), graduation plans, the academic calendar and the campus
directory. A folder here can overlap another collector; a page that collector
already keeps is not collected again.
skippedPages are office pages that are not collected, each with the reason:
WordPress test copies of other pages, and rosters or lists of named students
and alumni. skippedSections cut one section of a page, such as a block of
named students' testimonials; a cut whose heading is no longer on the page
leaves the whole page out.
